no corn syrup

Sweet is fine. Sugar-lab sweet is not. So we left the high fructose corn syrup on the bottom shelf where it belongs.

No seed oils

We skip the ultra-processed seed oils and use ingredients that actually belong in food. If it reads like a chemistry project, it’s not in this bottle.

no additives

No preservatives. No artificial nonsense. No “what is that?” ingredients hiding behind words you can’t pronounce.

Gluten Free

No gluten. No thickening tricks. No drama. Just sauce that plays nice with your diet and acts up on the grill.

## Why Bucks SauceWhy Bucks Sauce

We make small-batch BBQ sauce because big-batch tastes like sadness. We're ending boring BBQ.
0  1
### Small batches

Small runs. No conveyor belts, just slow simmering, constant taste checks, and Doug hovering like it owes him money.
0  2
### Real Ingredients

Real fruit. Fresh peppers. No powders. No syrups. No shortcuts. Fruit gets chopped, peppers get sliced, spices get blended by hand.
0  3
### Oh, This?

Philly Hot Sauce Fest 2026 — “Best Sauce on a Philly Cheesesteak” (2nd Place). Not bad for our first event.

## WHY?

### why Carry Bucks Sauce
- Flavor people remember — the kind that starts debates about who found it first
- Real ingredients your customers don’t have to Google
- A bottle with attitude — Glass. Bold. Shelf presence with teeth
- A backstory — Chef-built. Small batch. Not factory churned
- Repeat customers — our secret superpower



## What?

### what ourpartners get
- Wholesale pricing — room to win on every bottle
- Easy ordering — we don’t make you jump through hoops
- Fast turnaround — we ship quicker than people finish their first bottle
- Menu differentiation — a sauce that separates you from the place down the street
- Flavor that performs — Glazes. Caramelizes. Clings. Built for wings, ribs, and BBQ chicken pizza.
- Free customer education: “Yes, it’s that good”

## Who?

### Who Bucks Sauce Works For
- Specialty food shops
- Farm markets & co-ops
- Breweries & taprooms
- Butcher shops & meat counters
- BBQ joints & pizza shops
- Restaurants that refuse to serve average

It is not about cooking. It's about


# Buildingtheflavor

Superpower

After 20+ years in kitchens, building great BBQ sauce isn’t guesswork. We hear ingredients the way musicians hear chords — sweet, heat, acid, depth. If something’s out of tune, we fix it. That’s how harmony ends up in every bottle.

Meet Chef Doug

Doug first made the BBQ sauce at work — from scratch — and the reaction was immediate. Guests loved it. Chefs raved. That raised a bigger question: why didn’t anything on the shelf taste like this? He tried them all. None measured up. So he went back to the stove. For the next year, he tested, tweaked, and refined — dialing in the balance of real fruit, heat, and acidity until it locked in. That’s Bucks Sauce — small-batch BBQ sauce built by a chef, not a factory.

Homemade

Award-Winning

Small Batches

fresh ingredients

Put On Anything

New Merch

Doug tried every sauce on the market (official review: "they all sucked"). So he locked himself in the lab (a.k.a. his kitchen) like the RZA crafting beats. Fresh ingredients, real heat, a little cooking chemistry, and flavor that raised hell — and the bar.

Batch after batch, tweak after tweak, Doug finally created what he confidently calls:


T  h  e           b  e  s  t           s  a  u  c  e          e  v  e  r  .


No hfc

gluten free

no additives

no seed oils

# FrequentlyAskedQuestions

## Does it really taste that good?

Yes. We wouldn’t bottle it if it didn’t.

## Is it Gluten-Free?

Yes. This gluten-free BBQ sauce contains no wheat ingredients and no unnecessary thickeners — just clean, small-batch sauce.

## Is it spicy?

Depends on the bottle. Cherry is smooth and sweet with no heat.Pineapple Sriracha brings a mild, balanced kick.Habanero brings real heat — noticeable, bold, and built for people who mean it. From sweet BBQ sauce to hot BBQ sauce, you choose the level. We handle the balance.

## Does this BBQ sauce contain high fructose corn syrup?

No. Bucks Sauce contains no high fructose corn syrup, seed oils, or artificial additives. Just real food.

## Can I Drink It?

We built it for ribs, chicken, and burgers — not shot glasses. But we respect commitment.

# Crushed Pineapple Sriracha


Meet the Flavor That Makes You look Like a Better Cook


Taste Profile
- Sweet pineapple leads upfront
- Sriracha heat builds through the middle
- Clean, balanced finish with a kick
- Medium heat — sweet first, then a mild burn

Pairs With

BBQ chicken pizza, wings, shrimp skewers, grilled salmon, pork tenderloin, rice bowls, banh mi, chicken lettuce wraps, stir fry, noodles, crispy tofu.

No hfc

gluten free

no additives

no seed oils

t  h  e     s  a  u  c  e     t  h  a  t       d  i  d  n  '  t     e  s  c  a  p  e       t  h  e     l  a  b



Crushed Pineapple Sriracha BBQ sauce starts bright with real pineapple, then layers in tangy sriracha heat for a sweet-to-spicy balance that builds without overpowering. A versatile BBQ sauce for wings, shrimp, and grilled chicken. Coats beautifully. Finishes with a kick.

- No fillers
- No mystery “natural flavors”
- No cheap shortcuts
- Layers on layers of real, balanced flavor
- Built by a guy who takes sauce way too seriously


Starts with real ingredients

## Built on fireBuilt on fire

Ingredients

Nutrition

Organic Tomato Purée, Fresh Pineapple, Organic Pineapple Juice, Organic Brown Sugar, White Vinegar, Rice Vinegar, Chili Peppers, Molasses, Fresh Garlic, Browning Seasoning, Filtered Water, Organic Cornstarch, Cayenne Pepper, Sea Salt.

Pure AF. Seriously

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  7/14/2026



Bucks Sauce ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Bucks Sauce

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  July 14, 2026



Bucks Sauce is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Bucks Sauce

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

Last updated:  July 14, 2026



Use of this site constitutes agreement to the terms outlined below. Please read carefully before use.



## 1. Definitions


- "Company" - Bucks Sauce

- "User" - Anyone who browses or uses the site

- "Services" - Food & Beverage provided through the site




## 2. Description of Services


Bucks Sauce provides Food & Beverage through the site. The services are subject to the terms detailed in this document and may change from time to time.


## 3. Terms of Use


Use of the site is conditional on compliance with the following terms:


- Use of the site for lawful purposes only

- No interference with site operations or other users

- No uploading of offensive, illegal, or harmful content

- Respect for copyright and intellectual property rights

- No actions that may compromise site security




## 4. User Obligations

## 6. Limitation of Liability


Services are provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. The Company will not be liable for indirect, consequential, or special damages arising from use of the site, except where required by law.


## 7. Copyright and Intellectual Property


All content on the site, including text, images, design, and code, is protected by copyright owned by Bucks Sauce. Reproduction, distribution, or commercial use of content is prohibited without written permission.


## 8. Privacy


Collection and use of personal information is subject to our Privacy Policy. Use of the site constitutes agreement to the Privacy Policy as detailed separately.


## 9. Changes to Terms of Use


The Company may change these terms of use at any time. Material changes will be posted on the site with 30 days advance notice. Continued use after changes constitutes agreement to the new terms.


## 10. Service Termination


The Company may suspend or limit service at any time, including in cases of terms of use violations. In case of service termination, relevant provisions will remain in effect.


## 11. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution


These terms of use are governed by applicable laws. Any disputes will be resolved in accordance with local jurisdiction, with preference given to arbitration or mediation where possible.
